sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates via Frankfurter (annual average of daily rates, LCU per USD)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Lula's second term begins amid scandal fallout
geopolitical_news.summary: Re-elected in October, Lula starts a second term shadowed by the mensalão vote-buying scandal.

geopolitical_news.headline: São Paulo gang attacks paralyze city
geopolitical_news.summary: The PCC crime faction launches coordinated May attacks on police, killing dozens.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final loss to France
sport.summary: Zidane-inspired France knocks out the holders in Berlin; Ronaldo sets the all-time scoring record.

geopolitical_news.headline: Brazil wins 2014 World Cup bid
geopolitical_news.summary: FIFA awards the tournament to Brazil in October, the first in South America since 1978.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rio hosts Pan American Games
geopolitical_news.summary: The July games serve as a test run for Brazil's Olympic ambitions.

sport.headline: Copa América champions
sport.summary: Brazil thrashes Argentina 3-0 in the final in Venezuela despite fielding a weakened squad.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pre-salt oil reserves confirmed
geopolitical_news.summary: Huge offshore Tupi field estimates promise to make Brazil a major oil exporter.

geopolitical_news.headline: Financial crisis response
geopolitical_news.summary: Lula's government deploys stimulus as the global meltdown reaches Brazil late in the year.

sport.headline: Olympic bronze in Beijing football
sport.summary: The men's team settles for bronze after a semi-final defeat; the women take silver.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rio wins 2016 Olympics bid
geopolitical_news.summary: The IOC picks Rio in October, the first South American city to host the games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Brazil shines at G20 summit
geopolitical_news.summary: Lula plays a prominent role at the London summit on the financial crisis.

sport.headline: Confederations Cup champions
sport.summary: Brazil comes from two down to beat the United States 3-2 in the Johannesburg final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dilma Rousseff elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Lula's chosen successor wins October's runoff, becoming Brazil's first woman president.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rio police occupy Alemão favelas
geopolitical_news.summary: A massive November operation retakes drug-gang strongholds ahead of the World Cup.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final loss to Netherlands
sport.summary: Brazil blows a half-time lead in Port Elizabeth and exits South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dilma purges scandal-hit ministers
geopolitical_news.summary: A series of corruption allegations force out several cabinet members in her first year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Truth commission on dictatorship created
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress approves a commission to investigate 1964-1985 military-era crimes.

sport.headline: Santos wins Copa Libertadores
sport.summary: Neymar leads Santos to the continental title, their first since the Pelé era.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mensalão trial convicts ringleaders
geopolitical_news.summary: The Supreme Court convicts Lula-era officials in the landmark vote-buying trial.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rio+20 Earth Summit held
geopolitical_news.summary: World leaders gather in June with modest results on sustainable development.

sport.headline: Olympic silver in London football
sport.summary: Neymar's men lose the final to Mexico at Wembley, still chasing a first gold.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mass June protests shake government
geopolitical_news.summary: Millions march over bus fares, corruption and World Cup spending during the Confederations Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: US spying on Dilma revealed
geopolitical_news.summary: Snowden leaks show NSA surveillance of the president; she cancels a state visit to Washington.

sport.headline: Confederations Cup champions
sport.summary: Brazil crushes Spain 3-0 in the Maracanã final, with Neymar player of the tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dilma narrowly re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: She beats Aécio Neves in October's runoff as the economy slides into recession.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lava Jato corruption probe begins
geopolitical_news.summary: The Petrobras investigation erupts, eventually engulfing much of Brazil's elite.

sport.headline: Mineirazo: 7-1 World Cup humiliation
sport.summary: Germany destroys Brazil in the Belo Horizonte semi-final, the nation's worst ever defeat.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lava Jato engulfs political class
geopolitical_news.summary: Arrests reach top executives and politicians as the Petrobras scandal widens.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cunha breaks with government
geopolitical_news.summary: The powerful lower-house speaker defects, setting the impeachment machinery in motion.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Brazil loses to Paraguay on penalties; Neymar is suspended after an early red card.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dilma impeached and removed
geopolitical_news.summary: The Senate ousts her in August over budget maneuvers; Michel Temer takes over.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rio hosts Olympic Games
geopolitical_news.summary: The August games proceed despite Zika fears, budget chaos and political turmoil.

sport.headline: First Olympic football gold
sport.summary: Neymar scores the winning penalty against Germany in the Maracanã final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Temer hit with corruption charges
geopolitical_news.summary: Prosecutors charge the president twice over the JBS meatpacking bribery scandal.

geopolitical_news.headline: JBS plea bargain rocks Brasília
geopolitical_news.summary: Recordings and testimony implicate dozens of politicians in systemic graft.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification under Tite
sport.summary: Brazil becomes the first team to qualify for Russia 2018 after a stunning turnaround.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bolsonaro elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: The far-right ex-army captain wins October's runoff after surviving a campaign stabbing.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lula jailed for corruption
geopolitical_news.summary: The former president begins a 12-year sentence in April, barring his candidacy.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final loss to Belgium
sport.summary: A 2-1 defeat in Kazan ends Brazil's campaign; Neymar's theatrics draw mockery.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bolsonaro takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: He is inaugurated in January promising to crush crime and open the economy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Amazon fires spark global outcry
geopolitical_news.summary: Record blazes in August draw international condemnation of deforestation policy.

sport.headline: Copa América champions at home
sport.summary: Brazil beats Peru 3-1 in the Maracanã final without the injured Neymar.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID devastates Brazil
geopolitical_news.summary: Brazil becomes a global epicenter with one of the world's highest death tolls.

geopolitical_news.headline: Justice minister Moro resigns
geopolitical_news.summary: Sergio Moro quits in April accusing Bolsonaro of meddling in federal police.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Leagues halt in March; Palmeiras wins a delayed Libertadores in January 2021.

geopolitical_news.headline: Senate COVID inquiry blames Bolsonaro
geopolitical_news.summary: A probe accuses the president of crimes against humanity over pandemic handling.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lula's convictions annulled
geopolitical_news.summary: The Supreme Court voids his cases in March, restoring his political rights.

sport.headline: Second straight Olympic football gold
sport.summary: Brazil beats Spain in extra time in Tokyo; the Copa América final is lost to Argentina.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lula defeats Bolsonaro
geopolitical_news.summary: Lula wins October's runoff by a narrow margin, returning to power after 12 years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Election denial tensions mount
geopolitical_news.summary: Bolsonaro supporters block roads and camp outside barracks rejecting the result.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final loss to Croatia
sport.summary: Brazil falls on penalties in Doha despite Neymar's extra-time goal; Tite resigns.

geopolitical_news.headline: January 8 Brasília riots
geopolitical_news.summary: Bolsonaro supporters storm government buildings a week after Lula's inauguration.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lula begins third term
geopolitical_news.summary: He takes office in January vowing to rebuild democracy and the Amazon.

sport.headline: Historic home qualifying defeat
sport.summary: Brazil loses to Argentina at the Maracanã in November, a first home qualifier loss ever.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly floods hit Rio Grande do Sul
geopolitical_news.summary: May floods kill scores and displace hundreds of thousands in the south.

geopolitical_news.headline: BRICS expansion under Brazil
geopolitical_news.summary: Brazil helps steer the expanded bloc as it prepares to host the 2025 summit.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Brazil loses to Uruguay on penalties without the suspended Vinícius Júnior.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bolsonaro convicted over coup plot
geopolitical_news.summary: The Supreme Court convicts him in September for attempting to overturn the 2022 election.

geopolitical_news.headline: Belém hosts COP30 climate summit
geopolitical_news.summary: The November Amazon summit in Belém tests Brazil's claim to global climate leadership.

sport.headline: Ancelotti takes charge of the Seleção
sport.summary: The Real Madrid legend becomes Brazil's first foreign coach in May.
